source_program.name: HeyGen
source_program.summary: A public-facing avatar-video platform with an editable video studio, reusable avatars and voices, localization, brand controls, asynchronous generation, and live conversational avatars.

target_context.note: This is a standalone URL-owned twin. No target program limits or receives this implementation.

capabilities.name: Prompt-to-video planning
capabilities.observable_behavior: A user can enter a brief and receive an editable multi-scene plan containing script, visuals, voice direction, pacing, and captions before generation.
capabilities.user_outcome: A reviewable video project is created from one prompt instead of requiring every scene to be authored from scratch.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Structured planning agent plus a validated scene model, explicit revision state, and approval gate.

capabilities.name: Saved studio projects, scene editing, and brand kits
capabilities.observable_behavior: A studio exposes editable scenes, scripts, timing, media, text, layouts, music, captions, templates, brand colors, logos, fonts, and glossary rules across saved projects.
capabilities.user_outcome: The user can create, save, reopen, revise, brand, approve, and render a complete video project.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Durable versioned project store, scene editor, media composition pipeline, reusable brand kit, and review/approval workflow.

capabilities.name: Voice, accent, and cloning
capabilities.observable_behavior: A user selects a voice by language, locale, accent, style, emotion, and delivery controls, or uses an authorized cloned voice, with consistent settings across project scenes.
capabilities.user_outcome: Avatar narration can match the required language, accent, tone, rate, pitch, and identity.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Filterable voice catalog, provider-neutral TTS adapter, local speech engines, consent-gated voice cloning, and post-synthesis rate/pitch processing.

capabilities.name: Avatar generation and performance transfer
capabilities.observable_behavior: A user can create video from a public or custom avatar, enroll a consented digital twin, create reusable looks, and drive the avatar with speech or a performance video.
capabilities.user_outcome: A reusable presenter identity produces new moving, speaking video rather than a static image or metadata record.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Consented avatar library plus adapters for speech-to-video, audio-driven lip sync, portrait animation, and driving-video performance transfer, followed by artifact and motion validation.

capabilities.name: Background and brand composition
capabilities.observable_behavior: A project can use color, image, video, generated, blurred, or transparent backgrounds; presenter layouts; text and media overlays; captions; music; logos; and multiple aspect, resolution, and output formats.
capabilities.user_outcome: The rendered artifact has the desired visual setting and brand presentation instead of only an uncomposed talking head.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: FFmpeg-based timed composition, chroma key, overlay, drawtext, caption, audio-mix, dimension, format, and transparency pipelines with source/output receipts.

capabilities.name: Templates and reusable avatars
capabilities.observable_behavior: Users can persist templates, avatar identities, and avatar looks, then reuse those assets and presentation choices in later projects.
capabilities.user_outcome: Repeated videos preserve identity and production settings without recreating them each time.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Durable template and avatar stores with stable identifiers, consent records, source-asset hashes, and project revalidation on apply.

capabilities.name: Translation and dubbing
capabilities.observable_behavior: An existing project can be translated into another language, reviewed with glossary preservation, assigned a target-language voice, rerendered, captioned, and collected with other language variants.
capabilities.user_outcome: The same video can be delivered to multilingual audiences with localized speech and text.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Translation-provider adapter, glossary-aware review state, voice-language validation, new speech/avatar render, and multilingual artifact collection.

capabilities.name: Asynchronous API and artifact delivery
capabilities.observable_behavior: Programmatic clients submit video-generation jobs, inspect status, receive completion state, and retrieve generated artifacts without holding one synchronous request open.
capabilities.user_outcome: Applications can reliably automate longer-running video creation and retrieve validated results.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Persistent job records, bounded worker queue, HTTP API and CLI, status/result routes, streamed artifacts, and completion only after validation.

capabilities.name: Live conversational avatar
capabilities.observable_behavior: A configured avatar and voice can join a low-latency bidirectional session and respond using supplied knowledge and behavior context.
capabilities.user_outcome: The user can speak with a real-time avatar rather than only render prerecorded video.
capabilities.public_implementation_pattern: Provider-neutral HTTPS session adapter returning a secure WebRTC room, with lifecycle persistence that excludes room tokens and join URLs.

workflows.name: Create and approve a video from a prompt
workflows.observable_behavior: Enter a brief, inspect and revise the generated scenes, save the project, approve it, submit an asynchronous render, and download the verified artifact.

workflows.name: Enroll and reuse a custom avatar
workflows.observable_behavior: Record consent, enroll a source photo or training video, preserve the source identity, create reusable looks, and select that avatar in later projects.

workflows.name: Configure narration voice and delivery
workflows.observable_behavior: Filter voices by language and accent, select an engine and style, adjust emotion, speed, and pitch, or authorize a cloned voice, then apply the choice project-wide.

workflows.name: Compose and brand scene media
workflows.observable_behavior: For each scene choose presenter layout, background, headline, media overlay, captions, and timing, then apply music, logo, brand colors, glossary, aspect, resolution, and export format.

workflows.name: Translate and rerender a project
workflows.observable_behavior: Choose a target language, apply glossary rules, review the localized project, assign a compatible voice, rerender it, and add it to a multilingual collection.

workflows.name: Start and end a live avatar session
workflows.observable_behavior: Choose an avatar, voice, language, knowledge, and behavior context; obtain a secure real-time room; converse bidirectionally; and end the session without persisting the room secret.

limitations: The vendor's private source, model weights, training data, infrastructure, media catalog, and private endpoints are not public and are not copied or claimed.
Pixel-identical output and parity with undisclosed internal algorithms cannot be asserted; the independent implementation targets the same documented classes of user-visible outcome.
GPU-heavy generation, premium speech, translation, generated imagery, and live WebRTC require separately installed documented open models or operator-configured services.
coverage_gaps: Vendor-only asset inventory, billing, team administration, enterprise SSO, analytics, and other account-service behavior were not included in this media-creation branch.
